channels.name: CAN bus (CAN_H / CAN_L)
channels.purpose: Carries all CANopen communication objects; each object's CAN identifier is its COB-ID.

channels.name: COB-ID (logical)
channels.purpose: The CAN identifier of a communication object; maps the predefined connection set onto the bus.

global_signals.name: SYNC
global_signals.purpose: Network-wide synchronisation (default COB-ID 0x080) referenced by synchronous PDOs.

global_signals.name: Node-ID
global_signals.purpose: 1..127 identifier; keys the predefined connection set for the device's COB-IDs.

handshake_pairs.name: NMT command / state change
handshake_pairs.rule: Module-control command (COB-ID 0) drives the slave's NMT state.

handshake_pairs.name: SDO request / response
handshake_pairs.rule: Client reads/writes an OD entry (0x600+Node-ID); server replies (0x580+Node-ID) or aborts.

handshake_pairs.name: Boot-up
handshake_pairs.rule: After Initialisation the device announces Pre-operational (0x700+Node-ID, byte 0x00).

handshake_pairs.name: Heartbeat
handshake_pairs.rule: Cyclic heartbeat carries the NMT state; monitored against the consumer heartbeat time.

handshake_pairs.name: Node guarding
handshake_pairs.rule: RTR guarding frame; slave answers NMT state + toggle bit.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Every communication object is carried over a CAN frame whose identifier is its COB-ID, allocated by the predefined connection set from the Node-ID. A device must reach Operational (via NMT Start remote node) before PDOs flow; SDO and NMT are available from Pre-operational.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A synchronous PDO depends on the SYNC object; an SDO access depends on the addressed object existing in the object dictionary (index + sub-index); error control (heartbeat / guarding) depends on the configured times.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Pre-operational
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SDO and NMT communication allowed; no PDOs.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Operational
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: All communication objects active including PDOs.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Stopped
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Only NMT and error control allowed.

ordering_rules.bus_arbitration: Bus access is by CAN arbitration on the identifier (COB-ID); a lower COB-ID has higher priority. NMT control (COB-ID 0) is highest.
ordering_rules.state_order: Initialisation -> Pre-operational -> Operational; PDOs only in Operational.
ordering_rules.sync_order: Synchronous PDOs are ordered relative to the SYNC object.
